battle.name: 阿富汗戰爭
battle.theater: 喀布爾與興都庫什山區
battle.brief: 二〇〇一年十月七日聯軍發動持久自由行動，先以巡弋飛彈與艦載機摧毀塔利班防空與空軍，地面戰由北方聯盟與特種部隊引導。卡面是1862年英國鐵甲艦，木殼包鐵使裝甲第一次比火砲更難對付，砲塔自此繞著防禦展開；其後裔便是駐紮印度洋的航空母艦與護衛艦，阿富汗內陸沒有海港，重火力全靠海運。

kit.name: 鐵甲艦
kit.history: 木殼外面包了鐵。裝甲第一次比砲更難對付，砲塔的設計從此繞著它轉。

countries: 二〇〇一年十月起交戰的是以美國為主的聯盟、北方聯盟與塔利班三方。聯盟由美軍中央司令部統籌，最初投入第十海空陸戰隊、第八十二空降師、第十山地師與第一空騎師，第十一特遣部隊負責攻入喀布爾；英國是最早派兵的核心盟國，以航空母艦、驅逐艦與海軍陸戰隊參戰，地面部隊最初不過數百人，其後法國、德國、加拿大、澳洲、紐西蘭、波蘭、丹麥、挪威、荷蘭、西班牙、葡萄牙、意大利與土耳其等陸續加入。二〇〇三年北約成立國際安全援助部隊並接管防務，二〇〇六年全面主導，二〇一四年轉為支援任務，境內常駐兵力峰值約十三萬人。北方聯盟以馬蘇德的游擊網絡為骨幹，含伊斯蘭促進會、伊斯蘭黨等派系與杜斯杜姆的烏茲別克民兵，二〇〇一年時約二萬五千人。塔利班自一九九六年控制全國大部，由奧馬爾任最高領袖，兵力約四萬至五萬人，其中正規軍一萬餘人。巴基斯坦開戰初期允許西方使用空域與昆都拉、白沙瓦的後勤設施，二〇〇六年起拒絕派兵入阿。伊朗在西部口岸向北方聯盟與過渡政府供應物資。中國與俄羅斯於九〇年代中期先後承認塔利班，聯合國安理會以第一二六七、一三七三、一三八六號決議定下打擊框架。
countriesEn: Three parties were in conflict from October 2001: the United States-led coalition, the Northern Alliance and the Taliban. The coalition was directed by US Central Command, which committed the Tenth Marine Expeditionary Unit, the Eighty-Second Airborne, the Tenth Mountain and the First Cavalry at the outset, while the Eleventh Task Force was assigned the assault on Kabul. Britain was the first core ally to send troops, entering with aircraft carriers, destroyers and Royal Marines, its ground element numbering only a few hundred men at the start, and France, Germany, Canada, Australia, New Zealand, Poland, Denmark, Norway, the Netherlands, Spain, Portugal, Italy and Turkey followed in turn. NATO took over responsibility in 2003 with the International Security Assistance Force, assumed the lead in 2006 and shifted to a support mission in 2014, with resident strength inside the country peaking at around one hundred and thirty thousand men. The Northern Alliance was built on the guerrilla network of Ahmad Shah Massoud and included such factions as Jamiat-e Islami and Hizb-e Islami together with Abdul Rashid Dostum's Uzbek militia, numbering about twenty-five thousand men in 2001. The Taliban, in control of most of the country since 1996, counted Mullah Omar as its supreme leader and fielded between forty and fifty thousand men, of whom a little over ten thousand were regular troops. Pakistan allowed Western use of its airspace and of the logistics installations at Quetta and Peshawar at the start of the war, but from 2006 refused to send its own troops into Afghanistan. Iran supplied the Northern Alliance and the transitional government through its western crossings. China and Russia had recognised the Taliban in succession in the mid-1990s, and the United Nations Security Council framed the campaign in Resolutions 1267, 1373 and 1386.
people: 關鍵人物分屬三邊。塔利班方面，最高領袖奧馬爾自一九九六年掌權至二〇一三年，其時在開曼丹沙爾與巴基斯坦交界一帶被美軍無人機擊斃，接掌的曼蘇爾於二〇一六年十月在巴基斯坦查薩達附近同樣死於美方無人機，而被推舉為最高領袖的阿克塔爾·曼蘇爾在同年十二月被擊斃於東部。基地組織方面，奧薩馬·本·拉登自九一一事件後被通緝，二〇一一年五月在巴基斯坦阿伯塔巴德遭美軍海豹小隊突擊擊斃。北方聯盟方面，創建者艾哈邁德·沙哈·馬蘇德於二〇〇一年九月九日遇刺，距九一一僅兩日；其麾下將領接手隊伍，烏茲別克武裝首領杜斯杜姆在特種部隊火力支援下率部攻入馬扎里沙里夫。阿富汗政權方面，卡爾扎伊自二〇〇二年起出任總統，二〇一四年當選的加尼在二〇二一年八月離國。聯盟方面，總統布希在二〇〇一年九月二十日向塔利班下達最後通牒，國防部長拉姆斯菲爾德主持初期的推翻行動，中南部司令部司令弗蘭克斯全程指揮，第十一特遣部隊由麥克基爾南少將率領，特種作戰第一群的麥克里斯特在托拉博拉及其後戰役中居功至要。巴基斯坦方面，佩爾韋茲·穆沙拉夫在開戰初期提供空域與基地，其後政府改變立場，拒絕讓部隊進入阿富汗西部。
peopleEn: The decisive figures came from three sides. For the Taliban, the supreme leader Mullah Omar ruled from 1996 until 2013, when he was killed by a US drone near the border between Kandahar and Pakistan; his successor Mansour was likewise killed by an American drone near Charsadda in Pakistan in October 2016, and Akhtar Mansour, who had been named the Taliban leader, was killed in the east in December of the same year. For al-Qaeda, Osama bin Laden was under warrant from the moment of the September 11 attacks and was killed in a US SEAL raid at Abbottabad in Pakistan in May 2011. For the Northern Alliance, its founder Ahmad Shah Massoud was assassinated on 9 September 2001, two days before the attacks in New York, and the officers who had served under him carried on the fight, while Abdul Rashid Dostum led his Uzbek militia into Mazar-i-Sharif under the fire support of special forces. On the Afghan political side, Hamid Karzai was president from 2002, and Ashraf Ghani, who won the 2014 election, left the country in August 2021. On the coalition side, President Bush set the deadline of 20 September 2001 on the Taliban, Defence Secretary Rumsfeld directed the opening of the campaign, the CENTCOM commander Franks commanded throughout, the Eleventh Task Force was led by Major General McKiernan, and McChrystal of the First Special Forces Group was central to Tora Bora and the campaigns that followed. On the Pakistani side, Pervez Musharraf provided airspace and basing at the opening of the war, and his government later reversed course and refused to let Pakistani troops operate in western Afghanistan.
kits: 卡面是1862年英國鐵甲艦：木殼外加鐵甲帶，裝甲第一次比主砲更難對付，砲塔的設計自此繞著防禦展開，這條血統一路延續到二〇〇一年——英國皇家海軍以「光榮」號與「無畏」號輕型航艦、驅逐艦與核潛艇參戰，美國則派出「企業」號與「羅斯福」號兩個航艦戰鬥群；十月七日正是這些軍艦發射約四十枚戰斧巡弋飛彈，開啟了打擊陸上目標的火力。聯盟在海上還負責封鎖、護航、掃雷與人道物資運輸，英國掃雷艇其後在坎大哈港清除了蘇聯時期遺留下來的水雷。地面火力方面，美軍配備艾布拉姆斯坦克、布萊德利裝甲車、史崔克、悍馬與裝甲悍馬，機槍為M240與勃朗寧M2，迫擊炮有六十、八十一與一二〇毫米各型，野戰炮為一〇五毫米牽引炮與一五五毫米「帕拉丁」自行榴彈炮，反裝甲武器有標槍與拖薩；空中有B-1B與B-52轟炸機、F-15E與F-16戰鬥機、A-10攻擊機、AH-64阿帕奇、UH-60黑鷹、MQ-1掠食者無人機攜帶的地獄火與GBU-38炸彈，以及AC-130炮艇的夜間近距火力。北方聯盟與塔利班則以AK-47與AKM步槍、PKM與DShK重機槍、RPG火箭筒、蘇制ZU-23雙聯高射炮與一二二毫米榴彈炮作戰，皮卡改裝的「技術車」是其快速打擊的骨幹，阿富汗兵源的老式T-54與T-55坦克在巴格蘭一度成為攻擊目標。
kitsEn: The card shows the British ironclad of 1862: an iron skin laid over a wooden hull, the first time in naval history that armour was harder to defeat than the main gun, with turret design thereafter turning on defence, and that line of descent runs straight through to 2001, when the Royal Navy fought with the light fleet carriers Illustrious and Invincible, with destroyers and with nuclear submarines, while the United States sent the carrier battle groups Enterprise and Theodore Roosevelt; it was these warships that fired roughly forty Tomahawk cruise missiles on 7 October, opening the fires against targets ashore. At sea the coalition also ran blockades, escort work, minesweeping and the transport of relief cargo, and British minesweepers later cleared the mines left over from the Soviet years in the port of Kandahar. On the ground the Americans brought Abrams tanks, Bradley fighting vehicles, Strykers, Humvees and armoured Humvees, with the M240 and Browning M2 machine guns, 60, 81 and 120 mm mortars, the 105 mm towed gun and the 155 mm Paladin self-propelled howitzer, and the Javelin and TOW as anti-tank weapons; in the air flew B-1B and B-52 bombers, F-15E and F-16 fighters, A-10 attack aircraft, AH-64 Apaches, UH-60 Black Hawks and MQ-1 Predators carrying Hellfire missiles and GBU-38 bombs, with AC-130 gunships providing close fire at night. The Northern Alliance and the Taliban fought with AK-47 and AKM rifles, PKM and DShK heavy machine guns, RPG launchers, Soviet ZU-23 twin anti-aircraft guns and 122 mm howitzers, the pick-up trucks converted into technicals forming the backbone of their fast strike, and the old T-54 and T-55 tanks inherited from Afghan stocks became targets at Bagram.
tactics: 作戰分三個階段。頭一個月靠海空聯手：十月七日以巡弋飛彈、轟炸機與戰鬥機大規模打擊塔利班防空陣地、機場與燃料庫，殘存的米格二十一型在南部上空被逐架擊落，制空權到手後才放地面部隊進入；海上的航艦戰鬥群在阿拉伯海護航，並以艦載機在戰區上空提供戰鬥空中巡邏。第二階段是空地配合的突進：特種部隊與中央情報局小組分散滲入北方聯盟陣線，配上空中指揮官協調近距支援，北方聯盟的騎兵在空軍掩護下攻入馬扎里沙里夫，十一月初聯盟部隊進入喀布爾，坎大哈的攻城戰則以空地火力逐個壓平據點。十一月中旬坎大哈堡的守軍集體反叛並佔據堡壘抵抗，最後由空軍與地面火力攻破，數百名被俘的戰俘未能生還。第三階段自二〇〇二年起轉為長期據點戰：聯盟以巴格蘭、坎大哈、賈拉拉巴德與馬扎里沙里夫四個基地為骨幹，外加清剿部隊在鄉間搜索，特種小組夜間突襲，無人機與炮艇做精確打擊，後來交由阿富汗國民軍與國民警察在前線帶頭。二〇一四年之後聯盟退守基地，補給完全依賴巴基斯坦的托克哈姆口岸與公路車隊，後勤車隊成為伏擊與路邊炸彈最集中的目標。
tacticsEn: The campaign ran in three phases. The first month relied on sea and air together: on 7 October cruise missiles, bombers and fighters struck the Taliban air defences, airfields and fuel depots in bulk, the surviving MiG-21s were shot down one by one over the south, and ground troops were let in only once air supremacy was in hand; the carrier battle groups stood guard in the Arabian Sea and flew combat air patrols over the theatre from their decks. The second phase was the air-ground combination: special forces teams and Central Intelligence Agency officers filtered into the Northern Alliance lines, with airborne controllers coordinating close air support, and the Northern Alliance cavalry entered Mazar-i-Sharif under air cover in early November, coalition forces taking Kabul in the first days of the month, while the fighting for Kandahar was reduced position by position by air and ground fire. In mid-November the garrison at the Kandahar barracks mutinied and held the compound, which was finally broken by air and ground fire, and several hundred of the prisoners inside did not survive it. From 2002 the third phase turned the war into a long battle of strongpoints: the coalition built its base areas on Bagram, Kandahar, Jalalabad and Mazar-i-Sharif, added clearing operations in the countryside, night raids by special forces teams, precision strikes by drones and gunships, and later handed the front line over to the Afghan National Army and Afghan National Police. After 2014 the coalition withdrew into its bases and its supply came wholly through the Torkham crossing in Pakistan and along road convoys, which became the most heavily hit target of ambushes and roadside bombs.
data: 可核對的數字不少。開戰時美軍在役兵力約一萬人，塔利班軍隊約四萬至五萬人，其中正規軍一萬餘人，其餘為地方武裝；北方聯盟約二萬五千人。十月七日當天，四艘美軍軍艦發射約四十枚戰斧巡弋飛彈；開戰首週內有四架塔利班米格二十一型戰鬥機在南部上空被擊落，另有一架安二四被毀於地面。北約部隊在阿富汗的峰值兵力約十三萬人，美軍在整個戰區的兵力一度接近十萬人。美軍在阿富汗陣亡二千二百四十六人，其中作戰死亡二千一百七十七人，受傷逾一萬八千人；北約及其夥伴累計陣亡逾四千人，英軍逾四百五十人，加拿大分遣隊一千二百人中陣亡一百五十八人，為該國二戰以來最重的單次戰役損失。開支方面，美國聯邦政府直接撥款約三千七百七十億美元，加上退伍軍人照顧與利息超過八千億美元。阿富汗國土約六十五萬平方公里，人口約四千萬，國民生產總值約二百億美元，人類發展指數長期排在聯合國排名末段。巴格蘭監獄一度關押八千名以上囚犯，關塔那摩在二〇〇二年一度關押近五百人。阿富汗國民安全部隊自二〇一一年後陣亡逾三萬人。二〇二一年境內流離失所者超過二百七十萬，滯留巴基斯坦與伊朗的阿富汗人約五百萬。
dataEn: Quite a number of the figures can be checked. American troops committed at the opening numbered about ten thousand; the Taliban fielded between forty and fifty thousand men, a little over ten thousand of them regulars, the rest local militia; the Northern Alliance numbered about twenty-five thousand. On 7 October four American warships fired roughly forty Tomahawk cruise missiles, and within the first week of the war four Taliban MiG-21 fighters were shot down over the south, with an Antonov An-24 destroyed on the ground. NATO strength in Afghanistan peaked at around one hundred and thirty thousand men, and American forces across the whole theatre at one time approached one hundred thousand. American military dead in Afghanistan numbered two thousand two hundred and forty-six, of whom two thousand one hundred and seventy-seven were killed in action, with more than eighteen thousand wounded; NATO and its partners recorded more than four thousand dead in all, over four hundred and fifty of them British, while a Canadian contingent of twelve hundred lost one hundred and fifty-eight men, the heaviest single-theatre loss for that country since the Second World War. On cost, the United States federal government committed roughly three hundred and seventy-seven billion dollars directly, and more than eight hundred billion dollars once veterans' care and interest are added. Afghanistan has an area of about six hundred and fifty-two thousand square kilometres and a population of around forty million, with a gross domestic product of roughly twenty billion dollars, and it sat near the bottom of the United Nations human development ranking throughout. Bagram prison held more than eight thousand inmates at its peak, and Guantanamo held close to five hundred at one point in 2002. The Afghan National Security Forces lost more than thirty thousand dead after 2011. In 2021 more than two point seven million people were displaced within the country, and around five million Afghans remained in Pakistan and Iran.
cause: 打起來的原因可以分三層。最上層是九一一事件：二〇〇一年九月十一日，十九名基地組織成員劫持四架民航機，撞擊紐約世貿中心雙塔與五角大樓，另一架在賓夕法尼亞州墜毀。美國隨即要求塔利班交出本·拉登並關閉訓練營地，二〇〇一年九月二十日最後通牒到期而塔利班拒絕，布希於十月七日宣布發動持久自由行動。第二層是塔利班本身的處境：一九九六年起掌權的奧馬爾政府與美國斷交，只獲巴基斯坦、沙特與阿聯酋三國承認，國內因連年乾旱與多年戰亂而民生凋敝，軍隊裝備多為蘇制舊式武器，訓練與後勤能力薄弱，卻牢牢護住本·拉登與各處訓練營。第三層是北方聯盟的處境：馬蘇德在九〇年代於北方抵抗塔利班，卻因國際制裁而缺乏重武器，一旦美軍空襲牽制住塔利班，北方聯盟的游擊隊便能迅速轉為攻勢。三層疊在一起，才有聯軍空襲與地面推進的組合。
causeEn: The reasons for fighting can be read in three layers. The topmost is the attacks of 11 September 2001: nineteen al-Qaeda members hijacked four airliners, struck the twin towers of the World Trade Center in New York and the Pentagon, and a fifth aircraft came down in Pennsylvania. Washington then demanded that the Taliban hand over bin Laden and close the training camps, and when the ultimatum of 20 September expired without acceptance, Bush announced Operation Enduring Freedom on 7 October. The second layer is the Taliban's own position: the government of Mullah Omar, in power since 1996, had broken relations with the United States and was recognised by only three countries, Pakistan, Saudi Arabia and the United Arab Emirates; drought and long years of war had hollowed out the country, the army carried mostly old Soviet weapons and had little in the way of training or logistics, yet it shielded bin Laden and the camps closely. The third layer is the Northern Alliance's position: Massoud had fought the Taliban in the north through the 1990s but was starved of heavy weapons under international sanctions, and once American air strikes fixed the Taliban in place, the guerrilla bands could turn to the offensive at once. Only when the three layers met did the combination of coalition air strike and ground advance become possible.
impact: 這場戰爭改變了中亞與南亞的權力結構，也改變了西方對干預的信心。作戰層面，塔利班政權在四個月內瓦解，北約第一次依據第五條集體防禦條款在美國受攻擊後派兵，國際安全援助部隊成為北約史上最大規模的海外部署，峰值兵力超過十萬人；阿富汗國家軍與警察在此後十年擴編到數十萬人，接手了大部分地面任務。二〇一四年之後聯盟退守基地，戰爭重心轉為消耗戰，路面炸彈與伏擊造成的損失超過交火本身，阿富汗國民安全部隊的陣亡以萬計。政治層面，二〇〇一年波恩協議建立過渡政府，二〇〇四年憲法頒布，二〇一四年首次全國大選，但選舉引起的分裂與軍隊指揮層的摩擦令政府與美軍的關係惡化。二〇二一年撤軍之後塔利班重返喀布爾，阿富汗政府解散，國際援助大規模收縮，外來投資與駐軍一併撤走，國家重新陷入孤立與內部衝突。對西方自身而言，二十年後得到的教訓是：從空襲到地面治理的接縫太長，前十年用來推翻一個政府，後十年用來維持一個運作不起來的國家。
impactEn: The war rearranged the balance of power in Central and South Asia and changed Western confidence in intervention. On the military side the Taliban government dissolved within four months; NATO for the first time in its history invoked Article 5 and deployed forces after an attack on the United States, and the International Security Assistance Force became the largest overseas deployment in the alliance's history, with strength passing one hundred and thirty thousand men; the Afghan national army and police were expanded to several hundred thousand over the following decade and took over most of the ground tasks. After 2014 the coalition withdrew into its bases and the war settled into a war of attrition in which roadside bombs and ambushes caused more losses than direct fire, with Afghan security force deaths counted in the tens of thousands. On the political side the Bonn Agreement of 2001 created the transitional government, the constitution was promulgated in 2004 and the first nationwide election was held in 2014, but the divisions the election opened and the friction with the military leadership poisoned the relationship between the government and the United States. After the withdrawal of 2021 the Taliban returned to Kabul, the Afghan government dissolved, international assistance contracted sharply, foreign investment and foreign troops left together, and the country fell back into isolation and internal conflict. For the West itself the lesson after twenty years was that the seam between air strike and ground governance is very long: the first ten years were spent overthrowing a government, and the second ten were spent trying to hold a country that could not run.
result: 結果是開戰容易、收兵難。北方聯盟在二〇〇一年十一月底控制首都與北方要地，塔利班主力退回阿富汗南部與坎大哈一線，十二月初失去全部主要城市；二〇〇二年起戰事進入游擊與反游擊階段，美軍最終靠空襲與特種突襲於二〇一一年除掉本·拉登，但組織本身並未消失，轉向伊拉克、敘利亞與也門。聯盟在二〇一四年交出安全工作，二〇二一年八月塔利班攻入喀布爾，奧馬爾的舊部在數週內接管全國，聯盟部隊於八月三十日完成撤出，這場打了約二十年的戰爭，最後以撤軍收場。戰役期間美軍陣亡逾兩千二百人，聯盟總數逾四千人，這是美國歷時最長的一場戰爭。裝備層面的結果同樣明顯：塔利班在二〇二一年重新掌握國家政權與大批美製裝備，而聯盟二十年積累的阿富汗軍與警察編制則隨政府解散而散，武器留在原地，隊伍卻沒有留下來。
resultEn: The outcome was that it was easy to start the war and hard to end it. By the end of November 2001 the Northern Alliance held the capital and the northern positions, the main body of the Taliban fell back to southern Afghanistan and the Kandahar line, and by the first days of December it had lost all the major cities; from 2002 the fighting turned into a guerrilla war against a counter-guerrilla war, and it was by air strike and special forces raids that the Americans eventually removed bin Laden in 2011, though the organisation itself did not disappear and turned towards Iraq, Syria and Yemen. The coalition handed over security duties in 2014; in August 2021 the Taliban entered Kabul, Omar's old guard took over the country within weeks, and coalition forces completed their withdrawal on 30 August, a war of roughly twenty years ending in a withdrawal rather than in a decision. American dead in the campaign numbered more than two thousand two hundred, and more than four thousand for the coalition as a whole, in what was the longest war in American history. The result at the level of equipment is just as clear: the Taliban in 2021 again held the state and large stocks of American-made weapons, while the Afghan army and police formations built up over twenty years dissolved with the government, the weapons staying where they were and the units not staying with them.
